name: report_list
title: List the reports you may run
description:
Lists the report definitions the caller may run, with what each needs.
Returns: reports (name, tool, title, description, owner, tags, parameters, required, formats, classification, last_run) and count.
Inputs (none required): search (words in the name, title or description); tag.
Run one with its report_<name> tool or report_run; report_describe shows its sources.
Example: {"search": "calendar"}

search.description: Words to find in the name, title or description
